english.note: In casual speech, use this when describing a particular room or place as big and therefore roomy rather than choosing a dedicated word for spaciousness.

examples.english: Look at this room—it is so spacious that there is still room for several tables.
examples.traditional: 你睇下呢間房，好大，擺幾張枱都仲有位。
